scope: Targeted scientific-read-only and scientific-disabled only. Chromium light/dark small/medium/large; Firefox/WebKit light/dark medium. Each case has outlined and filled interaction captures; no full component acceptance.

evidence.htmlSource: Read-only extraction of the unmodified native HTML embedded ZIP; each case matched by unique title/project/attempt (JSON spec ids group projects, while HTML test ids differ by project). Both ids are preserved; each PNG is compared to its exact HTML attachment path.

decision: All40 MD3 originals individually reviewed; no new obvious visual defect within the targeted scientific locking scope.

images.title: NumberEdit md3 light small scientific-read-only
images.name: actual
images.viewMethod: view_image, individual original file; eight ordered groups of five images
images.conclusion: No new obvious visible defect within this scientific locked-state scope.
images.observations: Both fields show complete 1.25×10³ with aligned main text and raised exponent; outlined label/notch and filled label/value remain separate, descriptions and stepper icons are intact. Native readOnly semantics are established separately below.

lockingEvidence.selectorStateEvidence: Native readOnly=true/disabled=false in the corresponding measurement; readonly is not inferred from a static picture.
